ward.summary: Kandivali (ward R/S) spent ₹66.4 lakh against a ₹66.0 lakh budget, or 101%, leaving it over budget across 121 jobs. Repairs redone within 30 days were 21%, against 23% expected, and 56% of jobs finished on time, against 55% expected; both are in line with expectations. Repairs that failed account for ₹10.2 lakh. Eight jobs are listed for review, and 11 jobs worth ₹5.4 lakh were paid on roads under warranty. Next, the ward should address 26 open issues costing ₹7.6 lakh, starting with waterlogging on Link Road and a manhole on SV Road. With ₹0 left, only one fits, so funds must be reallocated or warranty payments recovered.
